evidence.quote: Coral reefs, specifically the Great Barrier Reef, would immensely benefit from dedicated satellite monitoring.
A near-real-time relay to monitoring stations on the ground would allow marine and conservation scientists to more accurately predict and react to coral bleaching events.

criteria.reasoning: Clear mission purpose, users and rationale with references. Lacks quantified mission requirements (resolution, revisit, spectral bands, data latency) and formal literature citations.

evidence.quote: Project work will be divided into weeks via a Gantt Chart.
Completed stages are gold. Incomplete stages are blue. Deadlines are indicated by red lines.

criteria.reasoning: Gantt chart and task descriptions show a feasible plan, but no contingency/variation provision, no explicit planned information-source list, and internal inconsistency between text and chart dates.
Some background research and STK tutorials completed, but no technical results, calculations or simulation outputs are presented to demonstrate design progress.

evidence.quote: Project work will be divided into weeks via a Gantt Chart.
Completed stages are gold. Incomplete stages are blue. Deadlines are indicated by red lines.

criteria.reasoning: Well-structured, readable and consistent formatting. Gantt is clear and labelled; footnotes match in-text citations. Minor issues: no formal reference list and figure caption absent.

technical_issues.issue: States a geostationary orbit at 600 km altitude; GEO altitude is ~35,786 km, and GEO cannot remain fixed above the non-equatorial Great Barrier Reef.
Bleaching mortality figures (60% in 2016, 50% in 2017) are not qualified as applying mainly to shallow-water northern GBR corals, not the entire reef.
Gantt chart shows Editing & Finalisation in Weeks 9–10, but text says Weeks 7–8; final report due 20/11 but chart ends 16/11.
No contingency or risk provision in the project plan.
No quantified mission requirements (spatial resolution, revisit time, spectral bands, data latency) are specified.
References are web URLs in footnotes without formal citation details or access dates.

overall: Strong mission rationale and readable report, but technical design is weak: incorrect GEO/600 km orbit, no preliminary technical results, and an incomplete project plan without contingencies or planned source list. Weighted score approximately 57/100.
